GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing just under a length, Restrained from upfront speed battle at the 900m, settled in 2 Lengths Two Wide middle stages, same past turn, ran on in Straight hitting Lead at 100m, went clear and kept going to post # solid win
Jumped well off a rails gate balanced up Two Wide fourth one x one 4 Lengths (800m), already being niggled 550, cornered Further back, held Ground from there # niggled before turn

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Four Wide , little change to 4 Lengths Four Wide turning, lost only a half length in the run home. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated it was obliged to race Wide and that had a detrimental effect on its finishing efforts. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # never on track
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout. Rdr stated obliged to race wide, which had a detrimental effect on gelding’s finishing efforts. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running approaching the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Held up for passing the 300m until shortly after entering the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , scrubbed along 4th Two Wide With Cover 3 Lengths 700m, Ridden Along getting to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up , grabbed minor placing, blinkers off again # grabbed placing

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , held rails touch better Mid Field 4 Lengths 700m, weaved off Leaders heels at 200m and was taken out a touch, chased bravely last 100m and got very close on line but Just missed # just missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Leaving the 200m, inconvenienced and then taken wider.
